item.title: Chipmaker unveils faster laptop processor, claims 30% gain
item.content:encoded:
The company announced a laptop processor it says is 30% faster than the previous generation. It ships in November and costs $499 for laptop makers. The chip uses a 3 nanometer process. Analysts expect the first laptops to arrive in time for the holidays. The company did not share battery life numbers. More details will come at a developer event later this year, the company said, adding that it has signed up several large laptop brands.

Rivals are expected to respond with their own chips next year.
